{{Vanilla|Igloo}}
An '''igloo''' generates as in vanilla, but [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its basement and chest loot.

== Structure ==
[[File:Igloo basement.png|thumb|220px|The pack's basement, with its ceiling removed]]
The basement template (<code>igloo/bottom</code>) is replaced.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/structure/igloo/bottom.nbt}}</ref> Its layout matches vanilla (stone-brick laboratory with a caged villager and zombie villager, a chest, a furnace and a cauldron), with these differences:
* The brewing stand holds a splash [[Pickled Crimson Fungus]] instead of a potion of Weakness. The pack removes potions from the game, and the item hints at one of the pack's [[secret recipes]].<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Changed Igloo Structure to reflect no potions (And show off a secret recipe)}}</ref> The item gives Weakness II for 1:00 when thrown. In 1.12.2-beta its item model is <code>minecraft:pickled_crimson_fungus</code>, which the resource pack doesn't define (the item's model is <code>matcha:pickled_crimson_fungus</code>), so it does not show the pickled crimson fungus texture.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/matcha/items/pickled_crimson_fungus.json}}</ref> Its tooltip also differs from a crafted one: it lacks the "throwable" line, and it has no custom potion color. An upcoming fix on the repository's <code>main</code> branch corrects the namespace and gives it the crafted item's tooltip and color.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/structure/igloo/bottom.nbt|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
* A potted crimson fungus stands in the room.
